title: Lurkrs
tagline: Lurkrs: The door to Web3 creativity made simple with no technological complications. Artists prosper and are rewarded while users collect creations and together they foster a vibrant ecosystem.
description:
Imagine Lurkrs as a cutting-edge platform that leverages Lens Protocol to enhance Web3 creativity. With our unique "Smart Post" feature, creators can easily share their content. The app cultivates an environment that champions innovation, allowing artists to showcase captivating content and engage in groundbreaking collaborations.

At Lurkers, challenges are transformed into exciting opportunities, creating a lively cycle of content creation, collection, and appreciation. Join the Lurkers community, where your creativity is not only acknowledged but wholeheartedly embraced. Dive into a world where your artistic journey is celebrated and seamlessly connected.
how_its_made:
Lurkrs is our cool project that we made together. We started with sketches on Figma and a plan on Miro. Then we used TypeScript and the T3 stack to build the app, adding in cool features like Wagmi, Lens SDK, and Privy.

Our journey had some ups and downs, but we figured things out and celebrated wins. Lens Protocol made it easy to share stuff and keep everyone in the loop.

In the coding part, we worked through the tech stuff, turning problems into cool things that make Lurkrs unique. Other tech partners blended in smoothly, making the project even better.

Our shared vision and some smart moves are what make Lurkrs awesome. It's proof that even a small team can make something cool with energy and a love for creating.
